statement.p: Find the volume between the cone y = \sqrt{x^2 + z^2} and the sphere x^2+y^2+z^2=36.

static.solution:
y-axis and intersects the sphere in the circle x^2 + (x^2 + z^2) + z^2 = 36, or x^2 + z^2 = 18
We use spherical coordinates with \phi measured from the y-axis and \theta measured in the xz-plane. The cone is given by \phi = \pi/4. The sphere has equation \rho =6. Thus \mbox{Vol } = \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{\pi/4}\int_0^{6} \rho^2\sin\phi\,d\rho\,d\phi\,d\theta, so \mbox{Vol } = \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{\pi/4} \frac{\rho^3}3 \sin\phi\Bigg|_0^{6} d\phi\,d\theta = \int_0^{2\pi} \int_0^{\pi/4} 72\sin\phi\,d\phi\,d\theta = \int_0^{2\pi} -72\cos\phi\Bigg|_0^{\pi/4} d\theta = \int_0^{2\pi} 72\left(1-\frac1{\sqrt{2}}\right)\,d\theta = 144\pi\left(1-\frac1{\sqrt{2}}\right).
